connector.name: Byte Protocol
connector.registryDescription: PayPerByte - per-byte data for AI agents: x402 USDC on Base, EIP-712-attested. No token.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.payperbyte.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package byte-mcp-server. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the 0rkz account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Ethereum private key for write/buy tools (subscribe, unsubscribe, publish, buy_data). buy_data spends real Base-mainnet USDC — use a dedicated wallet. Not required for read-only tools.

env.name: RPC_URL
env.description: RPC for the on-chain library + EIP-712 attestation layer (Arbitrum Sepolia, eip155:421614). The x402 buy rail settles USDC on Base mainnet and needs no RPC here. Defaults to Arbitrum Sepolia public RPC.
